items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Harrison Clark, I was practically right hand man to him

ctx.x: They have around about 5,000, more than that now, the last one I remember, and I was appointed by the grand master to serve at the junior grand master of ceremonies in '64 and '66. Harrison Clark, I was practically right hand man to him, and that time we had about -- maybe run about 7,000 or more. That's just one district, but they go by districts. See, like in Brooklyn's the second masonic district. And like Mount Vernon is the third, on up the scale, you know, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, all…
What do you do in the lodge now?
